name: Rane Crisis ~Bakunyuu Onna Kenshi Choukyou Sennou Keikaku~
original_name: Rane Crisis～爆乳女拳士調教洗脳計画～
source:
Vodan, who serves as a lord in the human realm, took over after his father's early death on the battlefield (his mother also died of illness when he was a baby) and kindly ruled the human villagers. Unlike his renowned warrior father, Vodan always spent his time in his governess's room, reading books and growing up as a bookish boy. Because of this, he couldn't help but feel anxious about the wars and conflicts erupting in neighboring countries.

After maintaining autonomy for a long time, Vodan, feeling the limits, sought an alliance with a mercenary force based in a fortress to the east. To his surprise, the diplomat who visited the mansion was a girl whose most noticeable feature was her large chest, giving an impression that she might lack intelligence.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120208012511/http://fox-tails.net/home/runecrisis5/]official site[/url]]
translation:
沃丹是人界的一名领主。父亲早早战死沙场、母亲也在他尚是婴儿时病逝后，他继承领地，以仁厚之道治理人类村民。沃丹的父亲曾是声名显赫的战士，他自己却截然不同：少年时代，他总待在乳母兼家庭教师的房间里埋头读书，最终长成了一名偏爱文事的青年。正因如此，邻国接连爆发的战争与冲突始终令他忧心不已。

领地长久维持自治后，沃丹渐渐感到独力支撑已到极限，便向以东方堡垒为据点的一支佣兵势力请求结盟。出乎他的意料，来到宅邸的使者竟是一名少女；她最引人瞩目的只有丰满巨乳，外表怎么看都不像具备多少才智。
